tagline: Leading global provider of data center, colocation and interconnection solutions
hero_kpi_rationale: The data center portfolio is the primary growth driver for the company, with a global presence across 310 facilities offering comprehensive colocation and interconnection solutions.

kpis.name: Data Center Portfolio
kpis.explanation: Number of data centers in the company's portfolio
kpis.description: Digital Realty's data center portfolio is one of the largest globally, with presence across multiple regions (118 in the United States, 113 in Europe, 36 in Latin America, 16 in Africa, 18 in Asia, 6 in Australia and 3 in Canada).

kpis.name: Occupancy Rate
kpis.description: Digital Realty's data center occupancy rate is high at 84.7%, indicating strong demand for its services and an increase of 0.6% year-over-year.
kpis.signal: High occupancy rate, with slight improvement

kpis.name: Space Under Active Development
kpis.explanation: Space currently under development or construction (thousands of square feet)
kpis.description: Digital Realty has 9,679 thousand square feet under active development, up from 8,904 in the prior year, an increase of 864, reflecting continued investment in capacity expansion.

kpis.name: Data Center Development Projects
kpis.explanation: Number of data centers under development or acquisition
kpis.description: Digital Realty continues its expansion with multiple development projects underway, including a joint venture with Bersama Digital Infrastructure Asia to develop data centers in Indonesia.
kpis.signal: Strong pipeline of new data center projects

risks.title: Inflation-related risks
risks.score_rationale: The risk is explicitly mentioned in Item 1A as potentially impacting the business directly or indirectly. The language is presented as significant, although without extensive detail. It represents a major macroeconomic risk for a USD-listed real estate asset.

risks.title: Real estate asset impairments
risks.score_rationale: While the provided text does not detail specific impairments in 2025, it notes that fair value estimates and assessments of recoverability for real estate and intangible assets are critical accounting policies involving significant judgment and subjectivity.

risks.title: Fair value estimation
risks.score_rationale: Fair value is used for acquisitions, dispositions and impairments. The text highlights the significant degree of judgment and subjectivity involved, which could materially impact financial results.

risks.title: Foreign exchange risks internationally
risks.score_rationale: Multiple currencies are involved (EUR, GBP, JPY, ZAR, BRL, etc.). The portfolio includes 189 international data centers (61% of total) out of 310. The risk is mitigated through swaps and local financing, but remains present.

risks.title: Concentration in rental revenues
risks.score_rationale: The majority of revenues come from leases with data center customers. The text specifies that revenue recognition depends on the probable collectability of rent, which could impact financial results in the event of tenant defaults.

risks.title: Integration of acquisitions and co-investments
risks.score_rationale: Digital Realty completed several major acquisitions and co-investments in 2025 (Blackstone joint venture, BDIA Indonesia, DC Partners NA Fund), creating operational integration risks and uncertainty around achieving expected returns.

ai_positioning.summary: Digital Realty identifies artificial intelligence as one of the key drivers of digital transformation and increasing demand for computing capacity, recognizing it as a critical technological advancement affecting data center growth.
evidence: The Internet of Things, 5G, autonomous vehicles and artificial intelligence, among other technological advancements, are driving this digital transformation.
